sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Access secure services, view your details and lodge online.

Deductions for self-education, conferences and training. You can't claim children's school fees or care.

Deductions for self-education expenses if the education has a sufficient connection to your employment activities.

You can't claim a deduction for child care, or for school or higher education fees for your children.

Deductions for attending seminars, conferences, and first aid or other training courses connected with your work.
